## `rc-keeper`

Keep `claude remote-control` running 24/7

**Usage:** `rc-keeper <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `daemon` — Daemon control. Bare `daemon` runs it in the foreground
* `status` — Show each instance with its runtime state
* `list` — List configured instances
* `add` — Add a folder as a new instance
* `edit` — Change an instance. Only given flags change
* `remove` — Remove an instance (stops it first)
* `start` — Start an instance, or all with --all
* `stop` — Stop an instance, or all with --all
* `restart` — Restart an instance, or all with --all
* `logs` — Print the last log lines of an instance
* `config` — Get or set settings
* `service` — Install, remove or inspect the login service
* `version` — Print the CLI version



## `rc-keeper daemon`

Daemon control. Bare `daemon` runs it in the foreground

**Usage:** `rc-keeper daemon [COMMAND]`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `run` — Run the daemon in the foreground
* `stop` — Stop the running daemon (exit 0 also when none runs)
* `status` — Show whether the daemon runs (exit 0 running, 2 not running)



## `rc-keeper daemon run`

Run the daemon in the foreground

**Usage:** `rc-keeper daemon run`



## `rc-keeper daemon stop`

Stop the running daemon (exit 0 also when none runs)

**Usage:** `rc-keeper daemon stop`

## `rc-keeper add`

Add a folder as a new instance

**Usage:** `rc-keeper add [OPTIONS] <FOLDER> [-- <EXTRA_ARGS>...]`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<FOLDER>` — Folder that `claude remote-control` runs in. Must exist. Stored as an absolute path
* `<EXTRA_ARGS>` — Extra arguments for `claude remote-control`. Add them after `--`, e.g. `add DIR -- --verbose`

###### **Options:**

* `--name <NAME>` — Session name shown in Claude. Passed as `claude remote-control --name`. Not set by default
* `--chrome` — Start with Chrome integration. Passed as `--chrome`. On by default for `add`
* `--no-chrome` — Start without Chrome integration. Passed as `--no-chrome`. Turns off the `add` default
* `--permission-mode <PERMISSION_MODE>` — Permission mode. Passed as `--permission-mode`. One of: acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, default, dontAsk, plan. Not set by default, so `claude` decides

  Possible values: `acceptEdits`, `auto`, `bypassPermissions`, `default`, `dontAsk`, `plan`

* `--spawn <SPAWN>` — Session spawn mode. Passed as `--spawn`. One of: same-dir, worktree, session. Not set by default

  Possible values: `same-dir`, `worktree`, `session`

* `--capacity <CAPACITY>` — Maximum number of sessions. Passed as `--capacity`. Whole number. Not set by default
* `--create-session-in-dir` — Create sessions in the instance folder. Passed as `--create-session-in-dir`. Not set by default
* `--no-create-session-in-dir` — Do not create sessions in the instance folder. Passed as `--no-create-session-in-dir`
* `--session-name-prefix <SESSION_NAME_PREFIX>` — Prefix for remote session names. Passed as `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`. Not set by default
* `--auto-trust` — Answer the folder trust prompt for this instance. On by default for `add`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-auto-trust` — Do not answer the folder trust prompt. You must trust the folder yourself. Not passed to `claude`
* `--auto-start` — Start this instance when the daemon starts. On by default for `add`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-auto-start` — Do not start this instance with the daemon. Start it with `rc-keeper start`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--force-boot` — When another `claude remote-control` serves the folder, stop it and start this instance. Kills without asking. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-force-boot` — Back off when the folder is busy instead of taking it over. Off by default. Not passed to `claude`



## `rc-keeper edit`

Change an instance. Only given flags change

**Usage:** `rc-keeper edit [OPTIONS] <SELECTOR> [-- <EXTRA_ARGS>...]`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path
* `<EXTRA_ARGS>` — Extra arguments for `claude remote-control`. Add them after `--`, e.g. `add DIR -- --verbose`

###### **Options:**

* `--name <NAME>` — Session name shown in Claude. Passed as `claude remote-control --name`. Not set by default
* `--chrome` — Start with Chrome integration. Passed as `--chrome`. On by default for `add`
* `--no-chrome` — Start without Chrome integration. Passed as `--no-chrome`. Turns off the `add` default
* `--permission-mode <PERMISSION_MODE>` — Permission mode. Passed as `--permission-mode`. One of: acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, default, dontAsk, plan. Not set by default, so `claude` decides

  Possible values: `acceptEdits`, `auto`, `bypassPermissions`, `default`, `dontAsk`, `plan`

* `--spawn <SPAWN>` — Session spawn mode. Passed as `--spawn`. One of: same-dir, worktree, session. Not set by default

  Possible values: `same-dir`, `worktree`, `session`

* `--capacity <CAPACITY>` — Maximum number of sessions. Passed as `--capacity`. Whole number. Not set by default
* `--create-session-in-dir` — Create sessions in the instance folder. Passed as `--create-session-in-dir`. Not set by default
* `--no-create-session-in-dir` — Do not create sessions in the instance folder. Passed as `--no-create-session-in-dir`
* `--session-name-prefix <SESSION_NAME_PREFIX>` — Prefix for remote session names. Passed as `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`. Not set by default
* `--auto-trust` — Answer the folder trust prompt for this instance. On by default for `add`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-auto-trust` — Do not answer the folder trust prompt. You must trust the folder yourself. Not passed to `claude`
* `--auto-start` — Start this instance when the daemon starts. On by default for `add`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-auto-start` — Do not start this instance with the daemon. Start it with `rc-keeper start`. Not passed to `claude`
* `--force-boot` — When another `claude remote-control` serves the folder, stop it and start this instance. Kills without asking. Not passed to `claude`
* `--no-force-boot` — Back off when the folder is busy instead of taking it over. Off by default. Not passed to `claude`



## `rc-keeper remove`

Remove an instance (stops it first)

**Usage:** `rc-keeper remove <SELECTOR>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path



## `rc-keeper start`

Start an instance, or all with --all

**Usage:** `rc-keeper start [OPTIONS] <SELECTOR|--all>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path. Give either this or `--all`, not both. An id wins when a folder path and an id match

###### **Options:**

* `--all` — Apply to every instance. Give either this or a selector, not both
* `--force` — Kills the other claude remote-control in the folder (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5 s), then starts. Destructive. Not with --all
* `--yes` — Skip the confirmation prompt for --force. Required when no terminal is attached



## `rc-keeper stop`

Stop an instance, or all with --all

**Usage:** `rc-keeper stop <SELECTOR|--all>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path. Give either this or `--all`, not both. An id wins when a folder path and an id match

###### **Options:**

* `--all` — Apply to every instance. Give either this or a selector, not both



## `rc-keeper restart`

Restart an instance, or all with --all

**Usage:** `rc-keeper restart <SELECTOR|--all>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path. Give either this or `--all`, not both. An id wins when a folder path and an id match

###### **Options:**

* `--all` — Apply to every instance. Give either this or a selector, not both



## `rc-keeper logs`

Print the last log lines of an instance

**Usage:** `rc-keeper logs [OPTIONS] <SELECTOR>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SELECTOR>` — Instance id or folder path

###### **Options:**

* `-f`, `--follow` — Keep running and print new lines as they arrive. Stop with Ctrl+C



## `rc-keeper config`

Get or set settings

**Usage:** `rc-keeper config <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `get` — Print all settings
* `set` — Set a setting. The only key is `claude-bin`
* `path` — Print the config dir (RC_KEEPER_CONFIG_DIR overrides it)



## `rc-keeper config get`

Print all settings

**Usage:** `rc-keeper config get`



## `rc-keeper config set`

Set a setting. The only key is `claude-bin`

**Usage:** `rc-keeper config set <KEY> <VALUE>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<KEY>` — Setting name. Must be `claude-bin`
* `<VALUE>` — Path to the `claude` executable, e.g. `/usr/local/bin/claude`. Stored only on this machine in `settings.local.json`



## `rc-keeper config path`

Print the config dir (RC_KEEPER_CONFIG_DIR overrides it)

**Usage:** `rc-keeper config path`



## `rc-keeper service`

Install, remove or inspect the login service

**Usage:** `rc-keeper service <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `install` — Write the service file and enable it
* `uninstall` — Disable the service and remove its file
* `status` — Show whether the service is installed and the daemon runs



## `rc-keeper service install`

Write the service file and enable it

**Usage:** `rc-keeper service install [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `--dry-run` — Write the service file only. Skip systemctl, launchctl and schtasks



## `rc-keeper service uninstall`

Disable the service and remove its file

**Usage:** `rc-keeper service uninstall [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `--dry-run` — Remove the service file only. Skip systemctl, launchctl and schtasks



## `rc-keeper service status`

Show whether the service is installed and the daemon runs

**Usage:** `rc-keeper service status`



## `rc-keeper version`

Print the CLI version

**Usage:** `rc-keeper version`
